annotations.description: Player searched for an Island instead of Urza's Tower, missing the opportunity to complete the Urza Tron set (already had Urza's Mine + 2x Urza's Power Plant). Completing Tron would have turned those lands from producing 3 colorless total into producing 9 colorless total — an extra 6 mana per turn. This would immediately enable Universal Solvent activation (7 mana) and Urza's Factory token generation (7 mana), both of which are game-dominating in Limited.
annotations.actionTaken: Searched for Island with Expedition Map
annotations.betterLine: Search for Urza's Tower to complete Tron. The massive mana advantage (going from 3 to 9 colorless from Urza lands) far outweighs the immediate need for blue mana, which can be found through normal draws. Tron online enables Universal Solvent and Urza's Factory activations that would dominate the game.

annotations.description: Targeting Brightmare (2/3) with Press for Answers instead of Daybreak Charger (3/1). The Daybreak Charger has 3 power and is the bigger offensive threat, so locking it down would save more damage. However, Brightmare is a better long-term body that's harder to remove through combat, so there's an argument for either target.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Brightmare (2/3) with Press for Answers
annotations.betterLine: Target Daybreak Charger (3/1) with Press for Answers to lock down the bigger offensive threat and save 3 damage from its next attack

annotations.description: Passed priority in precombat main phase with 4 untapped Plains and multiple castable spells. Could have cast Cloudshift on Brightmare to untap it and get its ETB trigger (tapping opponent's creature and gaining life), then attacked with both Daybreak Charger and Brightmare for 5 damage. Alternatively, could cast Inspiring Unicorn to develop the board. Instead, passed and wasted the entire turn's mana.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority with 4 untapped lands and castable spells including Cloudshift, Inspiring Unicorn, and Valorous Stance.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Cloudshift targeting Brightmare to untap it and trigger its ETB (gain 3 life from tapping Dutiful Replicator), then attack with Daybreak Charger and Brightmare for 5 damage. Post-combat, still have 3 mana for Valorous Stance if needed.

annotations.description: Player declined to crack a Clue token with exactly 2 mana available and no other use for that mana this turn. Drawing a card here is pure upside - they can't cast Drownyard Explorers (4 mana) with only 2 mana, and the opponent is building a threatening board with Inspiring Unicorn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without cracking the Clue token, wasting 2 available mana.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Clue Token to sacrifice it and draw a card for 2 mana, since there's no other use for the mana this turn.

annotations.description: All of opponent's creatures are tapped or summoning sick, and opponent has zero untapped lands (no mana for combat tricks). Dutiful Replicator 3/2 could attack for 3 unblockable damage with zero risk. GPT52 Nature is already behind on life (14 vs 20), making this free damage even more important.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Dutiful Replicator 3/2 for 3 free damage, bringing opponent to 17 life.

annotations.description: Passed priority in precombat main phase with 5 untapped Plains and multiple strong plays available. Could cast Valorous Steed (4W) to add a 3/3 vigilance and 2/2 vigilance knight before attacking with Inspiring Unicorn, which would pump the entire team. Alternatively, Faith's Fetters or Cloudshift could neutralize the opponent's only untapped blocker (Dutiful Replicator). Passing here wastes all 5 mana and misses a massive attack opportunity while ahead on board.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting any spells, effectively ending the main phase with 5 unused mana.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Valorous Steed (4W) to create a 3/3 vigilance and 2/2 vigilance knight, then attack with everything. Inspiring Unicorn's trigger would give all creatures +1/+1, resulting in a massive attack. Opponent only has Dutiful Replicator 3/2 as an untapped blocker.

annotations.description: With Inspiring Unicorn's +1/+1 buff, attackers are Daybreak Charger 5/3, Brightmare 4/5, and Inspiring Unicorn 4/4. The chosen blocks kill zero attackers while losing both blockers and taking 4 damage. By putting Dutiful Replicator (3/2) on Daybreak Charger (5/3), the Replicator's 3 damage kills the 3-toughness Charger, trading instead of dying for nothing against Brightmare's 5 toughness.
annotations.actionTaken: Dutiful Replicator blocks Brightmare, Drownyard Explorers blocks Daybreak Charger — kills nothing, loses both blockers, takes 4 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Dutiful Replicator blocks Daybreak Charger (trades, killing the Charger), Drownyard Explorers blocks Brightmare or Inspiring Unicorn — same 4 damage taken, same blockers lost, but removes an attacker.

annotations.description: With Drownyard Explorers (toughness 4) blocking Brightmare, Valorous Stance could destroy it ('destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater'), letting Brightmare deal 3 damage unblocked. Combined with Daybreak Charger's 4 unblocked damage, that's 7 total, putting the opponent to 3 life. Instead, the player cast Valorous Steed (a sorcery-speed creature that shouldn't even be castable in combat), which doesn't affect the current combat at all.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Valorous Steed during combat, which doesn't impact the current attack.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Valorous Stance targeting Drownyard Explorers (toughness 4) to destroy the blocker, letting Brightmare deal 3 unblocked damage for 7 total combat damage, putting opponent to 3 life — likely winning next turn.

annotations.description: Drownyard Explorers could attack for 2 damage completely unblocked. All of the opponent's creatures are either tapped or have summoning sickness, meaning there are zero available blockers. At 10 life vs 20 life, every point of damage matters, especially when the opponent has a threatening board that will untap next turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with Drownyard Explorers.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Drownyard Explorers for 2 uncontested damage, bringing the opponent to 18 life.

annotations.description: GPT54 Sport has lethal on board if they remove Drownyard Explorers (the only blocker). Valorous Stance can destroy it (toughness 4) for exactly their available 2 mana, clearing the way for 10 damage against opponent's 10 life. While they might plan to cast it later in combat, casting it now at beginning of combat is the safest line as it minimizes opponent response windows.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority at beginning of combat without casting Valorous Stance to remove the only blocker
annotations.betterLine: Cast Valorous Stance targeting Drownyard Explorers to destroy it, then attack with all creatures for exactly 10 lethal damage
